title: The orientation of N along a C¹ graph through x is the normalized Jacobian orientation (parent steps 11–15)
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, P := n + 1 + k, N ⊆ ℝ^P, ξ_N : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) an orientation of N (IsOrientation (n+1) N ξ_N: ξ_N is continuous on N and, for every y ∈ N, ξ_N(y) is a unit orientation of a subspace Q_y with Q_y = tangentSpace N y as sets), x ∈ ℝ^P, ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^P linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, δ > 0, and u : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^k of class C¹ on B := ball(0, δ) with u(0) = 0 and Du(0) = 0 (fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0). Put Γ(v) := x + ιv + ι'u(v). Assume Γ(v) ∈ N for every v ∈ B and ξ_N(x)(α) = α(ιe_0, …, ιe_n) for every (n+1)-covector α (e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1). Then for every v ∈ B and every (n+1)-covector α, α(DΓ(v)e_0, …, DΓ(v)e_n) = √det(DΓ(v)*∘DΓ(v)) · ξ_N(Γ(v))(α), where DΓ(v) = fderiv ℝ Γ v and DΓ(v)* is its adjoint.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid (n + 1 + k))) (ξN : Euclid (n + 1 + k) → MultiVector (n + 1 + k) (n + 1)) (x : Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (u : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid k) (δ : ℝ), IsOrientation (n + 1) N ξN → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 δ) → u 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0 → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, x + ι v + ι' (u v) ∈ N) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (n + 1), ξN x α = α (fun j => ι (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (n + 1), α (fun j => fderiv ℝ (fun v => x + ι v + ι' (u v)) v (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun v => x + ι v + ι' (u v)) v).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun v => x + ι v + ι' (u v)) v).det) * ξN (x + ι v + ι' (u v)) α
